sentences: The Anti-Breakthrough (Micro-Dosing): If long therapy sessions leave you more overwhelmed than helped, that's actually normal.
Perry explains that a dysregulated brain's "therapeutic window" is often only seconds long, so a sensitized, armored nervous system just can't take in sixty minutes of trauma processing.
So for now we need to give up the therapy ideal of the "hour-long breakthrough."
